exposure: urological incontinence during the pregnancy period
cohort: 5,013 women screened for pelvic floor function, of whom 410 were diagnosed with SUI
finding: The occurrence of stress urinary incontinence (SUI) is highly associated with a history of urinary incontinence, vaginal delivery, chronic cough, smoking, and a family history of SUI.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was significantly associated with a higher incidence of SUI compared to cesarean delivery.
